presentation.title: TypeSafe Triage Lab
presentation.summary: Inspect a deterministic triage engine with source and policy bindings. The Space makes explicit decisions without loading a language model or adapter.
presentation.stage: Software lab; learned-model promotion on hold
visible_limits: Learned-model promotion remains HOLD / NOT_PROMOTABLE. A running service does not establish model accuracy or immunity to prompt injection.
Decision content-integrity hashes are unsigned and do not authenticate an issuer.
Experimental research modules do not participate in live decisions or confer release authority.

cards.card_definition: export() local card f-string; published README.md is generated, not the repository root README.md
cards.hash_scope: Card hashes above are the generated README materialized with the prior canonical source SHA. Future source commits change its intentional revision interpolation and therefore its full/body hashes.
cards.source_readme_export_unchanged: The exact canonical root README.md continues to be copied as SOURCE_README.md.
cards.publisher_readme_mapping: export() creates README.md from its existing commit-parameterized card f-string after exporting canonical Git blobs; the original root README.md remains SOURCE_README.md. Only the card presentation literal changes.
cards.publication_trigger: Existing manual scripts/publish_software_space.py command only. Dry export is default and --publish is explicit. This source PR does not add a workflow or invoke export/publication.
cards.publication_boundary: The existing writer still requires exact current canonical main and git verify-commit before export; publishes only the canonical software package and policy, checks parent_commit, refuses unmanaged provider files, and verifies immutable remote bytes. No learned-model weights or historical outputs are added. BYTE_PARITY_VERIFIED, runtime witnessing and learned-model promotion remain separate states; NOT_PROMOTABLE is unchanged.
